Auxiliary roots and finals absorbed before all constraint sumchecks.
All zerocheck row points/claims fixed, then rho, compiled circuit and GKR binding.

existing_implications.PackedSourceExecution: Honest field/state computation -> one actual polynomial family and matching functionals/leaf values; does NOT extract that family from adversarial commitments.
existing_implications.FunctionalOpeningFold.functional_opening: For fixed sources and fixed coefficient weight tables before weighted PCS challenges, false existence of a matching representative implies accepted-count bound. Tables already depend on GKR challenges.
existing_implications.StructuredWeightTensor.compressed_tensor: A universal fixed tensor representative implies one lane tuple on common agreement points; obligation family must be fixed in advance.
existing_implications.GKRCommonInputBoundary.gkr_universal_fun: Equality for every final GKR weight functional implies equality of every fixed input slot, by gamma=0 and Boolean ru. No source extraction assumption hidden.
existing_implications.GKRCommonInputBoundary.gkr_adaptive_inpu: Moving representative after challenge invalidates universal separation: [r,r-1] has MLE at r equal zero for every r, yet no fixed vector equals this family. This does not pass authentication to a fixed source like [1,1].

needed_adversarial_contract.source_binding: Replace received authenticated leaf values by ONE fixed ordered source oracle family before all dependent verifier challenges; commitment/root extraction, including quantum semantics, is separate.
needed_adversarial_contract.extractor_prefix: For full AIR, polynomial tuple must be a function only of source+auxiliary commitment prefix before constraint row challenges. Fixing it merely before GKR proves only the terminal circuit reduction.
needed_adversarial_contract.near_case: There exists one degree-bounded lane tuple L selected at that prefix, with an explicit shared source-agreement/representation relation sufficient for every later terminal rowpoint, current/next slot, GKR ru/rv/gamma and PCS u. This is not independent existential per opening.
needed_adversarial_contract.far_case: If no such prefix-fixed tuple exists, bound accepted complete interactive paths for the actual universal contraction family, preserving all challenge causality and aborts. Existing fixed-weight PCS theorem does not prove this event.
needed_adversarial_contract.terminal_binding: Outside a bounded event, accepted mandatory PCS implies private_claim = sum_i private_weights_i * EvalTerminalInputs(L,rowpoints)_i for that same prefix-fixed L.
needed_adversarial_contract.composition: Prove actual GKR interactive reduction with this fixed input vector; then zerocheck/AIR reduction with prefix-fixed L, plus bus exact semantics. Circuit implementation lowering alone is not GKR soundness.

concrete_next_route: Model final GKR contraction universally over ru,rv,gamma; its private weights do not depend on prover messages. Existing Boolean spanning lemma identifies all private slots.

At fixed pre-GKR rowpoints, append weighted-PCS u coordinates and prove exact source contraction is a fixed multi-affine tensor. Use tensor extraction and shared interpolation before GKR challenge sampling, not separately after each transcript.

To cover AIR, extend the same universal tensor to all earlier zerocheck rowpoints (current and cyclic-next weights are multi-affine in those points). Same lane tuple must then cover all rows/slots/obligations.

Resolve variable GKR input dimension: terminal compiler constant-folds and deduplicates challenge-dependent constants, changing live constant count and input_size. A fixed envelope/padded layout profile is a clean new-profile option; do not assume the varying compiler is one fixed-degree polynomial map.

Alternatively add a separate independently randomized vector proximity/extraction stage fixed before zerocheck. This may simplify the common-witness theorem but needs its own far-case/adaptive/commitment security proof and cost; no certified parameters supplied.

finite_count_interface.form: For prefix-fixed arbitrary sources, count(accepted paths with no common L) <= B_global/|S| plus fold query term, after clearing denominators in the exact finite transcript tree.
finite_count_interface.recurrence_requirement: Each universal tensor coordinate needs a proved extraction-failure fiber bound and causal prefix. Existing IndexedUniqueExtraction supports a strict unique-decoding regime; applying its max(N,2) bound to extra GKR/rowpoint coordinates requires an actual tensor representation and accepted-event inclusion proof.
finite_count_interface.not_certified: No numerical B_global claimed: variable compiler shape, complete GKR reduction, universal-family sampling order and source-oracle extraction still require proofs.

security: No false-claim attack demonstrated; no QROM/PQ128 conclusion.
